cards.ex: After graduation, I just want to be footloose and fancy-free for a while before settling down.
cards.exUz: O'qishni tugatgandan so'ng, men bir muddat hech qanday majburiyatlarsiz, hayotdan zavqlanib yashashni xohlayman, keyin esa joylashaman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday majburiyatlarsiz, hayotdan zavqlanib yashash.

cards.ex: I feel hemmed in by all these rules and regulations at work.
cards.exUz: Ishdagi barcha qoidalar meni cheklagandek his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Atrofingiz to'siqlar bilan o'ralgan, harakat qilishga imkon yo'q.

cards.ex: That area of the factory is strictly off limits to visitors.
cards.exUz: Fabrikaning o'sha qismi mehmonlar uchun qat'iyan taqiqlangan.
cards.uzDef: Kirish yoki foydalanish taqiqlangan joy yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: During the storm, we were completely at the mercy of the elements.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron paytida biz butunlay tabiatning rahm-shafqatiga muhtoj edik.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamning yoki kuchning nazorati ostida, ularning qaroriga bog'liq.

cards.ex: The valuable documents are kept under lock and key.
cards.exUz: Qimmatli hujjatlar qulflangan joyda saqlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsiz joyda, qulflangan va hech kim kira olmaydi.

cards.ex: The manager gave me a free hand to reorganize the department.
cards.exUz: Menejer menga bo'limni qayta tashkil qilish uchun to'liq erkinlik berdi.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir ishni bajarishda to'liq erkinlik va mustaqillik.

cards.ex: The government needs to keep a tight rein on spending.
cards.exUz: Hukumat xarajatlarni qat'iy nazorat qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoki kimnidir qat'iy nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: Let's stop at the next rest area to stretch our legs.
cards.exUz: Keling, keyingi dam olish joyida to'xtab, oyoqlarimizni yozaylik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt o'tirishdan so'ng, harakat qilish va oyoqlarni yozish.

cards.ex: She broke the mold by becoming the first female CEO of the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaning birinchi ayol bosh direktori bo'lish orqali qolipni sindirdi.
cards.uzDef: An'analardan chetga chiqish, yangicha yo'l tutish.

cards.ex: The patient is still in intensive care, but the doctor says he's out of the woods.
cards.exUz: Bemor hali ham reanimatsiyada, ammo shifokor uning xavfdan holi ekanligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan chiqish, xavfdan xalos bo'lish.

cards.ex: As a rule of thumb, you should water your plants once a week.
cards.exUz: Qo'l qoidasi sifatida, o'simliklaringizni haftada bir marta sug'orishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tajribaga asoslangan umumiy qoida yoki amaliyot.

cards.ex: Don't let fear chain you down from pursuing your dreams.
cards.exUz: Qo'rquv sizni orzularingizdan zanjirlab qo'ymasin.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir harakatlarini cheklash, erkinligini olib qo'yish.

cards.ex: The new employee is being kept on a short leash by the manager.
cards.exUz: Yangi xodim menejer tomonidan qattiq nazorat qilinmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qat'iy nazorat ostida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: It's time for her to leave home and spread her wings.
cards.exUz: Uning uydan ketib, qanotlarini yoyish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish, mustaqil bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was determined to succeed by any means necessary.
cards.exUz: U har qanday yo'l bilan muvaffaqiyatga erishishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun har qanday yo'lga rozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: I feel boxed in by my current job; I need a change.
cards.exUz: Men hozirgi ishimdan cheklangan his qilyapman; menga o'zgarish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Cheklangan, harakat qilish yoki rivojlanishga imkon yo'q.

cards.ex: The decision is cut and dried; we're moving to a new city.
cards.exUz: Qaror aniq va tayyor; biz yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: So'zsiz aniq, o'zgarishga hojat yo'q.

cards.ex: I go for a run after work to let off steam.
cards.exUz: Men ishdan keyin stressdan xalos bo'lish uchun yugurishga boraman.
cards.uzDef: Stressdan xalos bo'lish, his-tuyg'ularni chiqarish.

cards.ex: He who pays the piper calls the tune.
cards.exUz: Kim pul to'lasa, o'sha ohangni buyuradi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazorat qilish, qarorlarni qabul qilish.

cards.ex: We don't have a set plan; we'll just play it by ear.
cards.exUz: Bizda aniq reja yo'q; shunchaki vaziyatga qarab ish tutamiz.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirmasdan, vaziyatga qarab ish tutish.

cards.ex: If you want to make a complaint, you have to go through the proper channels.
cards.exUz: Agar shikoyat qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, tegishli rasmiy yo'ldan o'tishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy tartibga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all competitors.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha raqobatchilar uchun teng sharoitlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng sharoitlar.

cards.ex: I need to talk to you and get something off my chest.
cards.exUz: Men siz bilan gaplashib, ichimdagi gapni aytishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birisiga o'zingizni bezovta qilayotgan narsani aytish, yengillashish.

cards.ex: Once we pay off the mortgage, we'll be free and clear.
cards.exUz: Ipotekani to'laganimizdan so'ng, biz ozod va toza bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qarzlardan yoki majburiyatlardan xoli.

cards.ex: I'm nervous about starting my own business, but I'm ready to take the plunge.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesimni boshlashdan qo'rqyapman, lekin qat'iy qadam tashlashga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rqinchli yoki xavfli bo'lishiga qaramay, biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: We're ready to start the project as soon as we get the go-ahead from the boss.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihani boshlashga tayyormiz, boshliqdan ruxsat olsak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilish uchun ruxsat olish.

cards.ex: Let the relationship run its course; don't force it.
cards.exUz: Munosabatlarga o'z yo'lini bosib o'tishiga ruxsat bering; majburlamang.
cards.uzDef: Hodisaning tugashiga ruxsat berish, aralashmaslik.

cards.ex: We wanted to explore some villages off the beaten path.
cards.exUz: Biz odamlarsiz yo'ldagi ba'zi qishloqlarni o'rganmoqchi edik.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur bo'lmagan yoki odamlarsiz joyda.

cards.ex: He's a law unto himself and does whatever he wants.
cards.exUz: U o'z qonuni va o'zi xohlagan narsani qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimning qoidalariga rioya qilmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: We want to go on vacation, but we don't want to break the bank.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'tilga bormoqchimiz, lekin bankni sindirmoqchi emasmiz.
cards.uzDef: Juda qimmat bo'lish, juda ko'p pul sarflash.
